body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17, re-verified); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches (Wall->Ledge paths) preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal. No painted depth cues without explicit user direction.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.

## SETTINGS + GEN-CONTROL SUITE (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
### Window
Five tabs (Generation / View & camera / Work & logistics / Combat & threats / Advanced), per-tab measured scrolls + resets, presets, reset-all confirm, ABGuard status panel with Re-arm (Disable records LastContext).
### Generation knobs (creation-time; defaults = old constants)
plateau openness (peakMeadowCutoff), meadow size (peakMeadowScale), edge band width (peakTerraceMax, curve reproduces old quantiles at 4), outcrop density, **tarns** (NEW water feature), **hidden valleys** (keep-sealed share; breached pockets get shortest-BFS canyon notches), soil, vegetation, sky + basement ore density, cavern chamber freq + formation density (BC-gated). Presets: Default/Dramatic/Subtle/Lush.
### Generation preview (studied Map Preview + Worldbuilder, 2026-07-22)
Right 45% of the Generation tab, outside the scroll: framed **Upper level / Lower level** panels rendering a seeded synthetic sample through the REAL classification math (cutoff/scale/terrace curve/outcrops/valleys/tarns/soil/veg). Open-air upper pixels = lower pixel dimmed 50% (the in-game see-below read). **True terrain colors** via the Map Preview 1x1-RenderTexture-blit technique (ABTrueColors, cached, hex fallbacks; lore saved under ui). Debounced 0.25s rebuilds (130x88 point-filtered Texture2D), legend chips, re-roll seed button, honest "illustrative sample" footnote. Map Designer reviewed: has NO preview (cards only); Worldbuilder's framed-image presentation copied.
### Landmarks on sky levels (Odyssey system; lore saved under world-incidents)
ABSkyLandmarks: LandmarkDef -> mutatorChances -> workers run by the CORE Mutator* GenStepDefs (PostTerrain 220 / CriticalStructures 500 / NonCritical 700 / Final 1600) added to AB_Sky's genSteps; our order-200 genstep rolls and `pocketTileInfo.AddMutator()`s first. Ticking/weather/save-load ride engine machinery. Per-landmark 4-state (user-approved ladder): **Disabled** never / **Random** pooled behind master chance (commonality-weighted) / **Enabled** deterministic when suitable (mutator biome white/blacklists vs the inherited sky biome) / **Forced** always. Master toggle + chance (30%) + max per level (1-3). Needs open plateau >= 80 cells (classic all-rock peaks skip). Defaults: Random, except aquatic/cave-term landmarks (coast/river/lake/cave/...) default Disabled. VLE + any landmark mod enumerate via DefDatabase. UI: collapsible list (deferred expando), icon + label + source mod + cycling mode button, description tooltips. Settings scribe by defName dict (mod-removal-safe). Odyssey-gated with dim note otherwise.

## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED)
Pure altitude transform; ScreenToBelowPos identity; mask dim 0.06; hairline skirt; wall-top reveal; multi-cell below-print anchor = first air cell; shrink exempts linked + rock/ores by def.

## COMPAT (ALL USER-VERIFIED): sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode (live-graphic detection). Probe reports fill branch/material/queues.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (#1-#15); pod transit + AA verified #39.
## 2026-07-21 TRANCHE: stair routing (self-test green), BC caverns (Earthen 55C), naturalistic peaks (verified #47), camera level lock (End).

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; combat/auto-engage/targeting-hub/animal-wander/ritual-attendance/mech-overseer/bond+home/pod-transit/stair-routing/cavern-basement/peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (fill branch report); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains (verified). Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + Vanilla Landmarks Expanded (soft via DefDatabase). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-22: Settings suite + gen preview + sky landmarks built green. Next run verifies: preview panel responsiveness (sliders/presets/re-roll), landmark list UI, then a gen run with a Forced ancient smoke vent to prove the mutator pipeline end-to-end (vent structures + smoke ticking on the plateau). Then older outstanding items (mech overseer, bond/home, VCHE run), soak, publishing prep. Save points through `pre-settings-rework`.
